title: recent: Fall back to default column width on mismatched formats
description:
The column widths are stored in recent, the actual columns are stored
in preferences. (The former are GUI-only, the latter apply to TShark,
etc. as well, so it's not as ridiculous as it sounds.) They are
generally in sync, but might not be if the columns are the default,
in which case they're not written to the preferences, and the user
switches between versions that have different sets of default columns.
(The recent values are always written.)

Commit 8c62a3918fe71d42097323f09e6470f30b3636e1 changed the set of
default columns, which can cause strange widths when going back and
forth in versions.

The values in recent store the formats; previously that was used for
lookup, but that caused issues if there were multiple columns of the
same type, etc. Use the format as a sanity check; if the format doesn't
match, then fallback to the default column width instead of using the
value from recent.
